name: Cart-Pole Balance
prompt: balance a pole on a cart

meta.name: Cart-Pole Balance
meta.tagline: Keep the pole upright as the cart and track get harder to control.
meta.description: Balance an upright pole by pushing its cart left or right. Keep the pole near vertical and the cart near the center as the track narrows and gravity increases; a tilt or a cart that leaves the track ends the episode.

rewardTerms.description: Time-weighted measure of how steadily upright the pole stays.
Time-weighted measure of how close the cart stays to the center.
Time spent applying force rather than coasting.

presets.name: default
presets.description: Balance the pole and keep the cart centered.

presets.name: aggressive
presets.description: Prioritize keeping the pole upright, even with brisk corrections.

presets.name: survivalist
presets.description: Favor lasting longer and avoiding excessive movement.

human.hint: Use the left and right arrow keys to push the cart; release both to coast.
